### CVE-2015-0565
- Assigner: Chrome | Published: 2020-02-25 | Updated: 2024-08-06 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: rowhammer
- Exploit-DB 36310: Linux Kernel (x86-64) - Rowhammer Privilege Escalation (local/linux_x86-64, 2015-03-09, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 36311: Rowhammer - NaCl Sandbox Escape (local/linux_x86-64, 2015-03-09, verified=1)

NaCl in 2015 allowed the CLFLUSH instruction, making rowhammer attacks possible.

Affected:
- NaCl / NaCL: affected 2015
